content:
Created 14 BAM Rust migration issues with full dependency graph:

PHASE 1 — Immediate (no blockers):
  #62: bam_aux_append → completes entire aux pipeline in Rust
  #63: bam_copy1 → pure Rust Record cloning
  #64: sam_parse1 → pure Rust SAM text parsing
  #74: sam_hdr_dup/destroy → Rust header lifecycle
  #75: sam_hdr_parse → Rust header text parsing

PHASE 2 — Architecture decision:
  #65: Evaluate bgzf/noodles-bgzf crate (BLOCKS EVERYTHING BELOW)

PHASE 3 — I/O layer (blocked by #65):
  #66: hts_open/close → Rust file handle management
  #67: sam_hdr_read/write → Rust binary header I/O
  #68: sam_read1 → Rust BAM record reader (also blocked by #64)
  #69: sam_write1 → Rust BAM record writer

PHASE 4 — Index/iteration (blocked by #65, #68, #70):
  #70: BAI/CSI index reader
  #71: Region query (blocked by #70)
  #72: hts_itr_next (blocked by #65, #68, #71)

PHASE 5 — Pileup (blocked by #68):
  #73: Pure Rust pileup engine

Dependency tree:
                #62 #63 #64 #74 #75  (no blockers)
                          |
                         #65          (BGZF crate evaluation)
                     /  / | \  \ 
                  #66 #67 #68 #69 #70
                          |        |
                          |       #71
                          |      / |
                         #72 ---/  |
                          |
                         #73

Total: replacing all BAM FFI requires ~14 issues across 5 phases.
Phase 1 can start immediately. Phase 2 (#65) is the critical gate.
